name: Creative Mode
description: A neo-brutalist editorial poster: warm cream paper, 4px ink-black borders, hard offset shadows and four saturated accents (forest green, hot pink, orange, yellow). Archivo Black uppercase headings (CJK falls back to bold Microsoft JhengHei), Space Grotesk body text, JetBrains Mono furniture. Everything is flat colour blocks: no gradients, no rounded corners, nothing soft. Ported from beautiful-html-templates’ creative-mode.

ink.use: text, 4px borders, hard shadows; background of inverted pages

accent.use: orange: second heading line, keywords, first layer of the hard shadow

surface.use: card, table header and code block background (paper one step darker)

line.use: borders and table rules, 4px or 2px ink black

green.use: poster blocks, chart fills, process nodes

pink3.use: pale pink of the toggle knob

yellow.use: circular ornaments, stand-in for glows, the fourth accent

display.family: 'Archivo Black', 'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Source Han Sans TC', sans-serif

body.family: 'Space Grotesk', 'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Source Han Sans TC', sans-serif

vocabulary: 60×3 ink rule with an uppercase monospace tagline
